subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should OpenClaw remove the shipped assistant-media `?token=` compatibility path now, or require a transition path before this PR lands?
rationale: The code change is narrow and security-positive, but repository policy treats fallback removal and fail-closed auth changes as compatibility-sensitive because existing upgraded users or custom clients may only discover it through 401s.

options.title: Accept removal now
options.body: Land this PR as a security hardening and document that assistant-media `?token=` and paired-device query-token URLs now fail closed.

options.title: Require transition path
options.body: Ask for a deprecation window, strict-mode gate, or compatibility note before removing the shipped fallback.

options.title: Coordinate with Tailscale media auth
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the open Tailscale assistant-media auth issue resolved together with query-token removal.

recommendation.title: Accept removal now
recommendation.body: Land this PR as a security hardening and document that assistant-media `?token=` and paired-device query-token URLs now fail closed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current media-ticket implementation and has recent history on the same gateway/UI media auth boundary.
